title: aristida tragopogon
intro: Aristida tragopogon, commonly known as false goat's beard, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, as well as being used as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Aristida tragopogon include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aristida tragopogon include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
